from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient


def create_presigned_download_url(config, object_name, expiry_time):
    credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    client = BlobServiceClient(config['account_url'], credential=credential)
    blob = client.get_blob_client(container=config['container'], blob=object_name)
    sas_token = blob.generate_blob_sas(permission='r', expiry=expiry_time)
    return f"{blob.url}?{sas_token}"

from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient


def get_object_metadata(config, object_name):
    credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    client = BlobServiceClient(config['account_url'], credential=credential)
    blob = client.get_blob_client(container=config['container'], blob=object_name)
    blob_properties = blob.get_blob_properties()
    return blob_properties

from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient


def list_objects_by_prefix(config, prefix):
    credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    client = BlobServiceClient(config['account_url'], credential=credential)
    blobs = client.get_container_client(config['container']).list_blobs(name_starts_with=prefix)
    return [blob.name for blob in blobs]

from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
from azure.cognitiveservices.vision.computervision import ComputerVisionClient
from msrest.authentication import CognitiveServicesCredentials


def ocr_stored_document(config, object_name):
    credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    blob_client = BlobServiceClient(config['account_url'], credential=credential)
    blob = blob_client.get_blob_client(container=config['container'], blob=object_name)
    download_stream = blob.download_blob()
    computervision_client = ComputerVisionClient(config['computervision_endpoint'], CognitiveServicesCredentials(config['computervision_key']))
    ocr_result = computervision_client.recognize_printed_text_in_stream(download_stream.content_as_bytes())
    return ocr_result.text

from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
from azure.cognitiveservices.language.textanalytics import TextAnalyticsClient
from msrest.authentication import CognitiveServicesCredentials


def translate_stored_text(config, object_name, target_language):
    credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    blob_client = BlobServiceClient(config['account_url'], credential=credential)
    blob = blob_client.get_blob_client(container=config['container'], blob=object_name)
    download_stream = blob.download_blob()
    text_analytics_client = TextAnalyticsClient(config['textanalytics_endpoint'], CognitiveServicesCredentials(config['textanalytics_key']))
    translated_text = text_analytics_client.translate(download_stream.content_as_text(), target_language)
    return translated_text

from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
from azure.cognitiveservices.language.textanalytics import TextAnalyticsClient
from msrest.authentication import CognitiveServicesCredentials


def summarize_stored_asset(config, object_name):
    credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    blob_client = BlobServiceClient(config['account_url'], credential=credential)
    blob = blob_client.get_blob_client(container=config['container'], blob=object_name)
    download_stream = blob.download_blob()
    text_analytics_client = TextAnalyticsClient(config['textanalytics_endpoint'], CognitiveServicesCredentials(config['textanalytics_key']))
    summary = text_analytics_client.summarize(download_stream.content_as_text())
    return summary

from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
from azure.cognitiveservices.language.textanalytics import TextAnalyticsClient
from msrest.authentication import CognitiveServicesCredentials


def embed_asset_metadata(config, object_name):
    credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    blob_client = BlobServiceClient(config['account_url'], credential=credential)
    blob = blob_client.get_blob_client(container=config['container'], blob=object_name)
    download_stream = blob.download_blob()
    text_analytics_client = TextAnalyticsClient(config['textanalytics_endpoint'], CognitiveServicesCredentials(config['textanalytics_key']))
    metadata_embedding = text_analytics_client.embed(download_stream.content_as_text())
    return metadata_embedding
